text.formatted: While in sunlight, the wight has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
text.plain: While in sunlight, the wight has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

text.formatted: The wight makes two attacks, using Necrotic Sword or Necrotic Bow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Life Drain.
text.plain: The wight makes two attacks, using Necrotic Sword or Necrotic Bow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Life Drain.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +4, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

text.formatted: _Ranged Attack Roll:_ +4, range 150/600 ft. _Hit:_ 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.
text.plain: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

text.formatted:
_Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 13, one creature within 5 feet. _Failure:_ 6 (1d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a **Zombie** under the wight's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The wight can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at a time.
